data.narrative:
Cellcolabs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Mattias Bernow that has raised $37M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods evaluated, only stage-progression analysis was applicable. This method uses the $37M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $74M. Peer-median analysis was not executable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within Biotech & Health—while 7 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies produced fewer than the three required datapoints. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied because revenue data for the private target is not available.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $85M (high), centered on a $74M median. This range reflects reasonable variance around the single applicable method, though its narrowness reflects a methodological constraint: the absence of adequate private peer data and missing revenue disclosure limits triangulation depth. Key uncertainties include stage-specific valuation inflection points for biotech companies in this funding cycle and Cellcolabs' revenue or clinical progress relative to named peers.
